items.title: Oracle says OpenAI contract is fully funded, addresses market financing scrutiny
items.summary: Investing.com -- Oracle Corporation (NYSE:ORCL) stated that it has secured the capital needed to fulfill its cloud infrastructure contract with OpenAI, describing itself as the first hyperscaler fully funded for the current artificial intelligence investment cycle. According to the company, a final capital raise earlier this month completed the financing framework previously outlined at its investor day, including vendor financing arrangements.

items.title: Billionaire Dan Loeb’s “Bear Math”: AI Needs $2-3 Trillion of New Yearly Revenue. He Sold Amazon
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThird Point’s Dan Loeb says $5 trillion to $7 trillion of AI spending from 2025 to 2030 needs $2 trillion to $3 trillion of new AI revenue a year to pay back. That’s a third to half of today’s roughly $6 trillion of global IT spending.
